name: Instrument: cello (bow)
notes: Your guitar bows a string an octave down. Your playing level is the bow's speed and force; a pluck becomes a long bowed note that fades in Hold; a hand on the strings lifts the bow. Physics: the bowed string (bow: stick and slip, Helmholtz motion, Schelleng's force limits). Guesses: the body eq (a few broad bumps where a cello body is loud, not a body model). Not physics: the pitch tracker (20-30 ms after the pick). Try Bow force: too little whistles, too much grinds.
